per_object_cap.notes: The first-party comparison table now lists a 300 GB per-file limit for guest and free member and 333 GB for the business plan; the hero states up to 300 GB without registration. The record's 333 GB figure is the business tier only.

retention.stated: Registered free members additionally get 111-day retention, send history and a receive folder. All free.
retention.notes: The first-party comparison table now gives 3-60 days for guest and free member (30 days maximum for files of 10 GB or more) and 3-111 days for the business plan; files are deleted automatically after the period. The record's 111-day figure for free members is now the business tier only.

egress.terms: No bandwidth meter on the free tier; the paid product is a business plan, not storage or transfer.

tooling: Web form at /upload (drag-and-drop, folder upload, password, download-count limit, one-time download). No API, no rclone backend.
chaining: Account-less uploads so 333 GB x unlimited objects; retention 3-111 days chosen per drop means the chain is a re-upload cron rather than an accumulating archive.
